name: Grace Sato
source:
Likes: Tea & alcohol

Backstory: Grace is the most well endowed woman among the group and she, and everyone else, knows it. She makes her feelings for the main character clear, but she's sometimes misunderstood in her intentions. Grace has worked with the MC in the past with her expertise in videography, editing, and music videos. She's enthralled when the main character contacts her to offer a position in a new record label they're creating.
